name: gcp-dynamic-dns
description: Automatically sync your public IP address to Google Cloud DNS records. Perfect for home servers, self-hosted services, and dynamic IP environments. Supports multiple IP detection methods including external services, local interface, and UPnP.

variables.name: DNS_NAMES
variables.description: Space-separated DNS names to update (must end with period, e.g., example.com.)

variables.name: GOOGLE_PROJECT
variables.description: Your Google Cloud Platform project ID

variables.name: GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS_JSON
variables.description: Service account JSON content (paste entire JSON key file content)

variables.name: MODE
variables.description: IP detection mode: service (external web services), interface (local network interface), or upnp (query router)

variables.name: INTERFACE_NAME
variables.description: Network interface name (only used when MODE=interface)
